name: Jack Dangermond
story: A contemporary November 2005 report records Jack Dangermond in Wellington to mark the tenth anniversary of the annual New Zealand Esri User Group conference, and Serge Peeters later recorded his 31 October 2006 presentation as part of the 11th Annual conference. The first meeting was held in 1995, followed by the numbered annual conference sequence from 1996.
